$comment: Mutation-target policy D-13 (design §15.4), issued by the human on 2026-10-05 (addendum §1). Targets are every src/**/*.ts and tools/lib/**/*.ts minus the thin adapters, Lambda shells, CLI wiring and declarative infra. Globs recompute added or moved logic automatically; tools/generate-quality-config.ts copies them into .c8rc.json and stryker.config.json and --check fails on drift. Shrinking this list needs a human decision.
